summary: Pre-launch smoke test for Planet Transfers. Verified: no fake testimonials, no star badge, all fleet images loading from Unsplash/Pexels, end-to-end booking flow (search → results → passenger details), admin dashboard login, and mobile responsiveness.

issues: 'Book Now' and 'Request Quote' buttons overflow off-screen to the right side of navbar — partially hidden at mobile width

action_items: Minor: Fix mobile nav overflow — 'Book Now' / 'Request Quote' buttons cut off at 375px viewport width
critical_code_review_comments: Flight number field on PassengerDetailsPage not found by standard selectors (input[name='flightNumber'] or input[placeholder*='flight']) — test found it as 'Flight Number *' with placeholder 'E.G. BA123', consider adding data-testid for testability
Confirm & Pay button text is dynamic ('Proceed to Secure Payment — £77.04') — ensure button is enabled/not disabled when required fields are filled (tested: button was enabled after form fill)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows pass. Booking flow: homepage → fill form → /results (10 vehicles from iWay live API) → Book Now → /passenger-details with full form. Admin at /admin with password 'planet2024' works. No fake testimonials or star badge present. Fleet images all load from Unsplash/Pexels. Only issue: minor mobile nav overflow at 375px.
